# Driveline Retail

> > Driveline Retail provides AI-powered retail solutions including merchandising services, logistics, robotics, and advanced analytics through proprietary platforms like SmartPMX, SmartMap, and SmartAIX.

Driveline Retail specializes in comprehensive retail execution services combining advanced technologies (AI, LiDAR, robotics, AR) with traditional merchandising and logistics operations. The company serves retailers and CPG manufacturers with solutions spanning inventory optimization, store resets, POS replenishment, and data-driven consulting services.

## Key Topics

- SmartPMX - AI-powered project management platform
- SmartMap - Store mapping and space optimization
- SmartAIX - AI analytics platform
- Retail Robotics - Autonomous shelf scanning and RFID
- POS Replenishment - Point of sale inventory management
- ESL Management - Electronic shelf labeling systems
- Planogram Compliance - Store layout execution
- Inventory Optimization - Demand forecasting and stockout prevention
- Store Resets and Remodels - Heavy project execution
- LiDAR Technology - 3D space capture and analysis
- DSD Support - Direct store delivery management
- Predictive Analytics - AI-driven retail insights
- Supply Chain Logistics - Distribution and kitting services
- Retail Continuity - Store recovery solutions

## Core Services

- [Advanced Retail Technology Solutions | AI, Robotics & AR](https://drivelineretail.com/advancedtech): AI analytics, robotics, LiDAR & AR solutions for retail optimization
- [AI-Powered Retail Distribution Services | Driveline Retail](https://drivelineretail.com/logistics): AI-driven logistics, kitting, fixture storage & POS replenishment
- [National Retail Heavy Project Execution | Driveline Retail](https://drivelineretail.com/heavydeployment): Heavy project execution: resets, remodels & new store setups nationwide
- [Advanced Retail Consulting & AI Solutions | Driveline Retail](https://drivelineretail.com/consulting): AI consulting, analytics, space optimization & LLM implementation
